description: issue #682 (slice I3): the multiline `when ... end when` form requires its closing label to match the block-head; closing a `when` block with `end every` is rejected at PARSE stage with `ol-mismatched-end` (spec/error-model.md's `ol-mismatched-end`; the `END_LABELS` registration C2 (#664) added for `when`). Because the parse fails, `execute()` bails before running anything, so no events are emitted. The diagnostic's span covers the wrong label word and its params carry the expected (`when`) vs actual (`every`) labels, with a did-you-mean pointing back at `when`.

diagnostics.message: this every doesn't close the block that is open. did you mean when?
